note: The layout check's case corpus (ui/tests/layout-cases.test.mjs): golden states with the findings the check must make on them (expect: the known faults it reproduces, each with its source in the validation of the check, ✓m measured in the prototype, ✓e expected from the audit's numbers), the findings it must not make (clear: the owner-cleared items, none yet), and what waits for data (pending: ✓d, once UI/UX declares it, or a ✓e the check does not reproduce). Each state's fixture log is ui/tests/layout-cases/<screen>/<state>.json; layout-check.mjs <logs> --refresh-cases takes them again after a retake. An expect matches a finding with that rule (and part, node, other as a prefix, container, measured: a number or [min, max]).
